text_description: A layered runway look centered on a long, open-front statement coat with a bulky, tactile surface of repeated horizontal chevron-like waves in golden beige, cream, and dark flecks, creating a shaggy fringed texture from shoulder to below the visible frame. The coat has a wide, turned collar and front edges outlined with small red and dark trim, and it hangs straight and generously around the body, framing the outfit underneath. Beneath it is a black, tailored-looking layer with broad lapel-like panels falling open at the chest, creating a deep V neckline and exposing an asymmetric striped garment below. The inner striped piece uses bold vertical and diagonal bands in red, white, black, green, and orange, with a sharp, graphic composition that runs down the torso and continues into the lower visible area; a small dark belt or tab detail crosses near the waist. The silhouette is elongated and layered, with the voluminous textured outer coat contrasting against the flatter, graphic, close-to-body striped underlayer. Styling includes large decorative drop earrings with dark and red accents, hair pulled back, and a polished runway mood with maximal texture and color blocking.
